lines.en: Theo, at my old school we were made to wear a uniform, and we were not allowed to wear jewelry.
lines.pt: Theo, na minha escola antiga fomos obrigados a usar uniforme, e não tínhamos permissão para usar bijuteria.

lines.en: Here we are allowed to choose our clothes, but we were made to sign a dress code at the start of term.
lines.pt: Aqui podemos escolher nossas roupas, mas fomos obrigados a assinar um código de vestimenta no início do semestre.

lines.en: That is a fair compromise. Our principal said that students were more relaxed when they were allowed to express themselves.
lines.pt: É um meio-termo justo. Nosso diretor dizia que os alunos ficavam mais relaxados quando podiam se expressar.

lines.en: My mother had the opposite experience. She was made to stand up whenever a teacher entered the room.
lines.pt: Minha mãe teve a experiência oposta. Ela era obrigada a ficar de pé sempre que um professor entrava na sala.

lines.en: That is old-fashioned. At my school, we were made to run laps if we arrived late, and nobody complained.
lines.pt: Isso é antiquado. Na minha escola, éramos obrigados a correr voltas se chegássemos atrasados, e ninguém reclamava.

lines.en: Seriously? Nobody complained? I would have protested. Students should be allowed to question rules, as long as they are polite.
lines.pt: Sério? Ninguém reclamava? Eu teria protestado. Os alunos deveriam poder questionar as regras, desde que sejam educados.

lines.en: Some did. A boy was made to apologize in front of everyone after he argued with the coach.
lines.pt: Alguns reclamavam. Um garoto foi obrigado a pedir desculpas diante de todos depois de discutir com o treinador.

lines.en: I see. At this school, we are not allowed to use phones in class, but we are allowed to bring them to the library.
lines.pt: Entendo. Nesta escola, não podemos usar celular na aula, mas podemos levá-lo para a biblioteca.

lines.en: That seems sensible. Last week the whole class was made to stay after school because someone had written on the wall.
lines.pt: Parece sensato. Na semana passada a turma inteira foi obrigada a ficar depois da aula porque alguém tinha pichado a parede.

lines.en: Unfair! Nobody should be made to take the blame for what one person did. Did the principal find out who?
lines.pt: Injusto! Ninguém deveria ser obrigado a assumir a culpa pelo que uma pessoa fez. O diretor descobriu quem?

lines.en: In the end, yes. He was made to clean the wall himself, and now the whole school is allowed to paint a mural there.
lines.pt: No fim, sim. Ele foi obrigado a limpar a parede sozinho, e agora a escola toda pode pintar um mural ali.
